Matrix-exponential Frobenius traces yield the normalized all-time first-jump formula, including its continuous Jordan value. The independent direct construction and exact symbolic checks replayed successfully (121 checks). Finite checks corroborate, not replace, the infinite proof.

Every k yields k distinct critical positive loss rates with explicit Jordan multiplicities and polynomial-exponential decay, while off half filling the dark space persists but positive-loss EPs disappear. These conclusions go materially beyond the known limiting capture invariant.
